terms.comment: Greek μοναχός, one who lives alone. Monks call one another brothers, frātrēs (Aug. Conf. 8.6.15). The same word in East and West.

terms.gloss: a monk who lives in a community
terms.comment: From coenobium, a house of common life (see monastery).

phrases.latin: ortus est sermō ipsō narrante dē Antōniō Aegyptiō monachō
phrases.english: and talk turned, as he told it, to Antony, the Egyptian monk

sources: Lewis & Short: monachus · Lewis & Short: coenobita
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. monk. Enrico Levi and Arturo Bini, Il latino come lingua viva (1937), p. 41, s.v. monaco.
